question: How do nudges change healthcare professional use of evidence-based medicine?
eligibility: Nudge or choice-architecture intervention aimed at healthcare professionals.
Targets evidence-based medicine or guideline-concordant clinical behaviour.
Empirical studies included in the scoping review.
as_of_source: Day after latest Entrez date among exact-title PubMed matches (lower bound).
source: Nagtegaal et al. 2019, Nudging healthcare professionals towards evidence-based medicine: a systematic scoping review. https://doi.org/10.30636/jbpa.22.71; SYNERGY labels (CC0): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asreview/systematic-review-datasets/metadata-v1-final/datasets/Nagtegaal_2019/output/Nagtegaal_2019.csv
notes: Gold includes 86 of 101 SYNERGY label_included records with exact PubMed title matches. The other 15 had no exact PubMed title match.
